text: The areas published in Série II were slowly split into other publications in ways that caused some confusion .

source.page_title: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences

text: In 1994 , Série II , which covered physics , chemistry , astronomy and geosciences , was replaced by Série IIA and Série IIB .

source.page_title: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences

text: Série IIA was exclusive to geosciences , and Série IIB covered chemistry and astronomy and the now - distinct mechanics and physics .

source.page_title: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences

text: In 1998 , Série IIB covered mechanics , physics and astronomy ; chemistry got its separate publication , Série IIC .

source.page_title: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences

text: In 2000 , Série IIB became dedicated exclusively to mechanics in May .

source.page_title: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences

text: Astronomy got redefined as astrophysics , which along with physics was covered by the new Série IV .

source.page_title: Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences

text: Série IV began publishing in March ; however , Séries IIB published two more issues on physics and astrophysics in April and May before starting the new run .

text: Jules Raphaël Bethenod ( 8 February 1910 – 16 June 1994 ) was a French racing driver .

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: He styled himself as Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux , and commonly competed under the pseudonym " Raph " .

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: Racing career

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: Bethenod competed in various European events .

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: He also competed in the U.S. on occasion .

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: In 1936 , he finished 42nd in the AAA - sanctioned Vanderbilt Cup , being disqualified after a push start .

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: Bethenod submitted an entry for the 1946 Indianapolis 500 , but failed to arrive .

source.page_title: Comte Jules Raphaël Bethenod de Montbressieux

text: Comunhão Reformada Batista do Brasil ( or Reformed Baptist Communion of Brazil in English ) was a federation of Reformed Baptist churches in Brazil .

source.page_title: Comunhão Reformada Batista do Brasil

text: It was founded on June 10 , 2004 in Petrolândia , Pernambuco by individuals from different denominations that subscribed to the 1689 Baptist Confession of Faith in Brazil .

source.page_title: Comunhão Reformada Batista do Brasil

text: The fellowship of churches were theologically Reformed ( but credobaptist ) , and subscribed to the doctrines of the Five Solas ( Sola Scriptura , Solus Christus , Soli Deo Gloria , Sola Fide , and Sola Gratia ) .

source.page_title: Comunhão Reformada Batista do Brasil

text: The organization was dissolved sometime following the 6th Congress meeting that was held in 2011 .

source.page_title: Comunhão Reformada Batista do Brasil

text: Many Reformed Baptist churches in Brazil now belong to the Convenção Batista Reformada do Brasil ( or Reformed Baptist Convention of Brazil ) , which was founded during the 500th anniversary of the Protestant Reformation on October 31 , 2017 .

source.page_title: Comunhão Reformada Batista do Brasil

text: The Concepcion Islands are 17 variously inhabited and uninhabited islands in northeastern Iloilo , Philippines .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: The islands are politically subdivided into 11 island barangays and are part of the municipality of Concepcion .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: According to the 2010 census , the islands collectively have a population of 19,080 , 48 percent of the total population of the municipality of Concepcion .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: In 1604 , Juan Salgado twice defeated Spanish pirates near Pan de Azucar .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: During World War II , Japanese forces shot down an American fighter pilot , which crash landed near Bag -o Abo Island .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: The Concepcion Islands are located east of Panay Island in the Visayan Sea , and are part of the larger Western Visayas archipelago .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: The islands are part of the town of Concepcion , and comprise 40 percent of Concepcion 's total land area .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: The nearest island is Tago , which is a coral reef 200 metres ( 660 ft ) from the mainland , inside Concepcion Bay .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: The furthest island is far - flung Baliguian , located 22 kilometres ( 14 mi ) away from the mainland .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: Baliguian also marks the end of Concepcion 's municipal waters .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: The majority of the islands are mountainous and wooded , ringed by white sand beaches and surrounded by reefs , shoals , and sandbars .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands

text: A few of the islands feature lighthouses to aid ship navigation in this area .

source.page_title: Concepcion Islands
